title: When Does Muon Actually Win? A Paired Data-, Time-, and Tuning-Budget Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.21555v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Muon's gains in data efficiency motivate evaluating its performance under explicit data, time, and tuning budgets. On a single A100 GPU, we compare a reference single-device Muon implementation with AdamW across 17.7M- and 33.6M-parameter causal language models and 2.70M-parameter vision transformers. A common 23-candidate development budget selects configurations evaluated with five matched seeds, full validation trajectories, optimizer-step timing, and a frozen one-shot test. Muon reduces validation-loss area under the curve by 3.25--22.44\% at equal data and lowers test loss in all 20 primary pairs. In this configuration, Muon improves time-normalized loss area} by 19.68--22.31\% on vision, while AdamW is better by 3.38--6.96\% on language. translated_title: Muon究竟何时胜出？一项配对的数据、时间与调参预算基准测试
translated_abstract: Muon在数据效率上的提升促使我们在明确的数据、时间和调参预算约束下评估其性能。在单张A100 GPU上，我们将参考的单设备Muon实现与AdamW在17.7M和33.6M参数的因果语言模型以及2.70M参数的视觉Transformer（ViT）上进行对比。我们采用一个共有的23个候选配置的开发预算来选择超参数，并使用五个匹配的随机种子、完整的验证轨迹、优化器步骤计时以及冻结的一次性测试进行评估。在相同数据量下，Muon将验证损失的曲线下面积（AUC）降低3.25%–22.44%，并在全部20个主要配对实验中降低了测试损失。在该配置下，Muon在视觉任务上将时间归一化损失面积提升19.68%–22.31%，而在语言任务上AdamW则以3.38%–6.96%的优势表现更佳。完整的Muon优化器调用（包括辅助的AdamW更新）消耗56.1%–69.6%的训练时间，相比之下AdamW基线仅占6.1%–9.1%。此外，Muon还具有更高的期望遗憾。
tldr: 在单GPU、配对的数据/时间/调参预算基准测试中，Muon在视觉任务上时间归一化损失显著优于AdamW，但因优化器自身耗时较高（占训练时间56%–70%），在语言任务上反而落后于AdamW。
en_tdlr: Under matched data, time, and tuning budgets on a single GPU, Muon beats AdamW in time-normalized loss on vision tasks, but its substantial optimizer overhead makes it lose to AdamW on language tasks.
